name: TextBox 2
text:
• Vision-language models can describe images fluently while adding assumptions that the image does not establish.

• The risk is highest when a prompt invites a judgment about identity, health, personality, social behavior, or demographics.

• This project tests whether a system can inspect its expressed claims during inference and revise unsupported or bias-relevant content using visual evidence.

• The approach does not access hidden chain-of-thought and does not retrain the model.

name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
Research Question

Can a multimodal AI system detect unsupported or bias-relevant assumptions in its generated response during inference and autonomously revise the response using visual evidence?

Scope
• Operate on claims expressed in generated output
• Use evidence checking and bias monitoring at inference time
• Avoid additional training or full model retraining

Target contribution
Evidence-grounded, claim-level, multimodal inference-time correction.
